question: Which substances constitute the second enumerated set of ritual ingredients?
premises: The verse provides another list of six named items.
The items include mustard, saffron, dūrvā, costus, lāmañjaka, and camphor.
The list functions as a parallel enumeration to the previous verse.
inference: This verse specifies a second group of six ritual substances.
uncertainties: śaśī is glossed as camphor following the hint, though it can also mean moon.
